text_block_list.text:
Her grandmother's house stood in a secluded place, surrounded by colorful flora.
Whenever Sweep Tosho had a day off, she spent it there.

Alongside her grandmother, who lived the carefree life of a 'Great Witch'—
as a 'Magical Girl' studying magic.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Now then, ready, Sweepy?
Just like I taught you—give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Okay, Grandma! Here goes~...!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Zera-zera uninium~☆

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Good, very good. Go on, take a sniff.
Smells sweet, bright, and delightful, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Sniff, sniff... Ah, it really does!!
Awesome, awesome! It worked...!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Yes, your 'Herb Geranium Magic' was a success.
This strong fragrance keeps pesky bugs away—

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that, it makes an exceptionally delicious herbal tea and jam!
Now, Sweepy, help me pick them.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Okaaaay!
Fufufu~ Zera-zera♪ U~nini~um...♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(Amazing! Magic is so, sooo much fun!!
I wanna do more... I wanna learn tons and tooons more!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Grandma!
I wanna learn even more spells, but—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What was the spell that you thought was
the 'most amazing' of all?

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text: Oho, number one, you say! ...Well then—

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text: ...That might just be the "Magic of Racing."

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
The racing world is a special place, full of all kinds of magic.
It can make your heart race, fill you with wonder... and sometimes, bring you sorrow.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
But there's an extraordinary spell you can only cast out there on the track.
A long, long time ago, back when I used to race, I found it myself.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
My sweet little Sweepy.
If you ever manage to cast that spell—

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
You might discover a "joy" more thrilling than anything else in the world—
one that could change your entire life.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Nnnngh!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Then my mind's made up! I'm gonna race too!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
And I'll DEFINITELY find the most amazing magic in racing,
just like Grandma did!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Aha ha ha ha! Is that so, is that so?
...I can't wait to see what kind of magic you'll weave.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Magic is supposed to be fun.
It's supposed to blow all your boredom away, poof!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I came all the way to Tracen Academy to search for the "Magic of Racing"
so I could cast even more and better spells, but...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much I run, I can't find any magic at all!
And the trainers and teachers just boss me around, exactly like back during all those boring lessons!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I hate this, it's not fun at all! It's super boring!!
Everything, absolutely everything has gotten so boring!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...*sigh*.
Maybe I should just... quit racing altogether.
choice_data_list: That would be such a waste...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh—

The words slip out of my mouth without a second thought.
...Because the sight of her run during the mock race was still burned into my memory.

And above all—hearing her story made me feel as though
I finally understood what her grandmother was trying to do.

All those lessons she took weren't fun at all, no matter how good she got at them.
That was because she had never truly "wanted" to do them in the first place.

What mattered most was that she felt that spark of desire herself.
That's why her grandmother showed her magic—to give her something she truly wanted to pursue.

And so, Sweep Tosho made up her own mind,
entering the racing world because it was something *she* wanted to do.

Only she could paint her life with joy and make it shine.
But if she's hitting a wall she can't overcome alone right now—
choice_data_list: Are you really okay giving up on the "Magic of Racing"?
Are you really okay giving up on the "Magic of Racing"?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Nnnngh... Of course I'm not okay with it, dummy!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Because it's the greatest magic of all!
And I'm Sweepy, the one who's gonna be a great witch someday!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I promised myself!
I promised I'd find the "Magic of Racing," just like Grandma did...!
choice_data_list: I know you can find it.
I know you can find it.

text_block_list.text:
I declare it firmly, doing my best to convey absolute confidence.
And then, I explain.
choice_data_list: The way you ran was truly "magical."
The way you ran was truly "magical."

text_block_list.text:
I earnestly tell her that that's genuinely how it looked.
Wishing with all my heart that this little apprentice witch before me never loses sight of magic.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hyahhh!!

Hoping that she, holding boundless potential to run anywhere she desires,
can overcome this small stumble and move forward along her chosen path.
choice_data_list: Would you like to see the wider world of racing?
Would you like to see the wider world of racing?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
A wider world...?
...Could I really find magic there?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Then congratulations, you're my "familiar" starting today.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Are you slow? Dummy. A familiar has to stick by their magical girl master
and do absolutely everything to help them out!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You have to tag along until I find "racing magic"!
Got it?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hey, familiar!! If you understand, stop spacing out and answer me!!
—It feels like I've gotten myself into something completely crazy!
